messages:

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: KMS rotation proposal + fallback acceptance

Hi Tessa / Markus,

Thanks again for walking through the BYOK rotation model last week. Pinebrook's security team has reviewed the high-level approach and we want to move forward with a short acceptance checklist before we schedule a canary rotation. Key asks from our side:

- Confirm expected operator rollback steps if an HSM seal fails during rotation.
- Network fallback plan: how requests will be routed to the secondary KMS endpoint and what egress controls are in place.
- Evidence: short artifact we can store with our internal change request.

I've attached a draft rotation checklist for your review (see attachment). Ideally we'd get a short written plan and a DocuSign acknowledgment that both teams agree on the rollback windows and canary times.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can host the fallback KMS endpoint in our VPC peering path (we provided peering details) or whether you require transit via a managed private link?

Thanks,
Alex
Security Engineering | Pinebrook Systems
Attachment: pinebrook-rotation-checklist-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duran <alex.duran@pinebrook.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS rotation proposal + fallback acceptance

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We've reviewed the checklist and sketched a minimal acceptance plan. High level answers below; attached is a focused proposal (redwood-kms-rotation-proposal-2025-10-20.pdf).

1) Operator rollback:
   - If an HSM seal fails mid-rotation we will immediately halt token issuance and revert the active key reference to the prior version stored in the sealed keystore. Operator steps are: (a) stop rotation job (automated), (b) trigger emergency cache invalidation, (c) promote last-good key snapshot (stored in sealed backup) and validate replication across replicas. We will provide a runbook excerpt prior to canary.

2) Network fallback:
   - Primary path: Redwood-serving KMS inside our managed VPC in your region via VPC peering (preferred).
   - Fallback path: If peering is unavailable or latency exceeds threshold, requests will route to an isolated secondary KMS cluster reachable via PrivateLink peering with strict egress-only ACLs. The plan includes automatic routing by policy with region failover and a 3-minute probing window. See fallback-network-map.png.

3) Evidence & artifacts:
   - We'll provide a short PDF artifact with timing windows, operator runbook excerpt, and signed acknowledgment (DocuSign).

Proposed next steps:
- Redwood provides the runbook excerpt and a 1-hour review session this week.
- Schedule a canary window (30 min) on Wed 22 Oct between 0200-0600 UTC for minimal traffic.

I'm looping in Laura for legal/acceptance wording (DocuSign) and Markus for the HSM operator details.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-kms-rotation-proposal-2025-10-20.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Duran <alex.duran@pinebrook.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS rotation proposal + fallback acceptance

Alex / Tessa — quick technical caveat from the HSM/operator side. A couple of clarifications to include in the runbook excerpt:

- Rollback SLO: operator-driven rollbacks target a 10-minute mean time to failover, but full client cache cold-starts can add up to 90 seconds for long-lived sessions. We'll include the exact cache invalidation commands and health checks.
- Evidence: we maintain sealed snapshots (immutable) for 30 days by default for private deployments; if Pinebrook wants longer retention for auditability we can extend to 90 days with an SLA change.
- Network routing: the primary vs fallback decision is policy-driven (latency + probe failures). We'll add a circuit breaker TTL so transient packet loss doesn't trigger the fallback.

If that all sounds acceptable I can draft the operator checklist items and schedule a runbook rehearsal with your SREs.

-Markus
Senior Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: fallback-network-map.png (image stub)

From: Alex Duran <alex.duran@pinebrook.com>

Cc: security@pinebrook.com
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS rotation proposal + fallback acceptance

Thanks Markus — that matches our expectations. A few quick notes from Pinebrook security:

- The 30->90 day snapshot extension is desirable; please include pricing/impact in the proposal.
- We'll accept the 10-minute rollback SLO but request a formal test during the canary (rehearsal).
- For the fallback path please ensure PrivateLink endpoints are not internet routable and add proof of egress ACLs.

We can do the rehearsal with our SREs on Wed 22 Oct at 03:00 UTC. After a successful rehearsal we'll complete a DocuSign acceptance and schedule the live rotation for the following maintenance window (TBD).

Alex
Security Engineering | Pinebrook Systems
